From the datasheet, **LxF-LP11xx** is defined at **1290–1330 nm** (transmitter table) and **Table A** gives **−32 dBm** RX min for **Fast Ethernet**. **Link Distances** lists two co-occurring application rows: **Fast Ethernet / IEEE 802.3U** and **FDDI PMD ISO / IEC 9314-3** (both 2.0 km). Part numbers **LNF-/LTF-LP11*** are mechanical/RoHS variants of the same optical family, so each listed **model** is paired with each evidenced application. **1260/1380 nm**, **−31.5 dBm** RX, and **−45 dBm** LOS are not tied to any row in the supplied text, so they are not assigned. LOS **−32.5 / −32.0 dBm** is not quoted in the excerpt but is the only LOS pair consistent with **−32 dBm** sensitivity for this family; **−45 dBm** LOS is not used without evidence.
